args.message:
Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) per FIN-212

The docstring claims banker's rounding per FIN-212, but the implementation
used ROUND_HALF_UP. Update round_money() to quantize with ROUND_HALF_EVEN
so ties round to the nearest even cent, matching tests/test_money.py.

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented `round_money()` using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: changed `round_money()` to quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`. The docstring already documented banker's rounding per FIN-212; the implementation now matches.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

E.g. `2.675 -> 2.68` and `2.665 -> 2.66` (ties round to the nearest even cent).
